name: Lower Danube frontier after Adrianople
legal_context: Russo-Ottoman peace settlement confirming the position of the Danubian Principalities
territorial_scope: The Danube from the Iron Gates to the delta as the southern limit of Wallachia
notes: Drawn along the river's general course at provincial scale. The instrument is a text; no delimitation map has been identified, so this line carries none of the river's actual meanders.

name: Danube and Bessarabian frontier after Paris
legal_context: General settlement after the Crimean War; a European commission was charged with delimitation
territorial_scope: Southern Bessarabia returned to Moldavia and the Danube mouths placed under commission
notes: The ledger records that commission geometry is required and has not been obtained. This is the schematic line the settlement implies, not the commission's.

name: Dobrudja frontier after Berlin
legal_context: Independence recognised; southern Bessarabia to Russia and northern Dobrudja to Romania
territorial_scope: The line from the Danube near Silistra east to the Black Sea
notes: The Berlin map exists but is not georeferenced. The Silistra sector was contested in the delimitation itself, which is why the interpretation is recorded as ambiguous rather than settled.

name: Southern Dobrudja frontier after Bucharest
legal_context: Settlement after the Second Balkan War
territorial_scope: The Turtucaia-Balchik line, carrying the Cadrilater to Romania
notes: Held until the 1940 Treaty of Craiova returned the Cadrilater to Bulgaria; that instrument is not in the ledger and the phase therefore ends where the ledger's evidence does.

name: Hungarian-Romanian frontier after Trianon
territorial_scope: From the Tisza plain south to the Danube at Bazias
notes: The frontier the treaty fixed, drawn schematically. Its interpretation is recorded as disputed because the settlement itself was contested, not because the line's position is unclear. The de Martonne proposal for the same zone is retained beside it and the two are never averaged.

name: De Martonne ethnographic proposal for the same frontier
legal_context: Expert ethnographic cartography prepared for the peace conference
territorial_scope: A proposed line through the same contested zone
notes: Retained as a competing line for the same moment rather than averaged with the treaty line. The two are different kinds of claim - one an instrument, one an argument - and reconciling them into a single frontier would erase the disagreement the trench exists to show.

name: Second Vienna Award line
legal_context: Axis arbitration transferring northern Transylvania to Hungary
territorial_scope: From the western frontier east and south around Cluj, then north-east through the Szekely counties
notes: The award's annex map has not been acquired, and the line's course through the Szekely Land is the part this reconstruction is least confident about. Drawn to show that the award cut across the province rather than along it.

name: Trianon frontier restored at Paris
legal_context: Post-war settlement annulling the Vienna Award
territorial_scope: The 1920 frontier restored; southern Dobrudja stays Bulgarian
notes: The same course as the 1920 line, recorded as its own phase because a frontier restored by instrument is a separate legal fact from the frontier it restores. Open-ended: this is the frontier still in force.
